newsitem.title: USA: Donna Karan in search for new CEO - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Donna Karan in search for new CEO - WSJ.

text.p: Donna Karan International Inc directors are looking for an outside executive to take over day-to-day operations of the apparel firm and are considering replacing founder Donna Karan as chief executive, the Wall Street Journal said.

In Thursday's electronic edition, the Journal said the search was initiated by Karan, who would remain chairman and the chief designer of the company but would hand over the chief executive's slot to someone with a strong financial background.
The move comes shortly after the company announced a $4.8 million cost-cutting plan amid grumblings from investors and analysts that costs are growing much faster than sales.

The Journal said a new chief executive would allow Karan to focus more attention on the creative-end of the business, but allow her to retain control over the fashion house she spent more than a decade building.
